subject.title: [Feature]: Collapsible messages in Control UI chat

question: Should Control UI add inline collapse for long assistant Markdown, and what default threshold, latest-message behavior, and global-control policy should it use?
rationale: The missing behavior is a UX product choice rather than a broken existing contract, and current code already has overlapping side-reader, JSON, tool, and duplicate-message disclosure patterns that should stay coherent.

options.title: Approve bounded inline collapse
options.body: Implement a small first version that collapses older long assistant messages by line or height threshold, keeps the active/latest response readable, and leaves global controls for a follow-up unless maintainers want them now.

options.title: Prefer existing side reader
options.body: Decline inline collapse for now and treat the canvas/sidebar reader as the supported long-message escape hatch.

options.title: Defer to broader chat UX
options.body: Keep the issue open but wait for a broader chat readability and accessibility design before adding another disclosure state.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded inline collapse
recommendation.body: Implement a small first version that collapses older long assistant messages by line or height threshold, keeps the active/latest response readable, and leaves global controls for a follow-up unless maintainers want them now.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent Control UI chat scannability and sidebar work makes this the best available product-routing candidate from the history found.
